definitions: A fully managed, composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana for visualization and analysis.
A cloud-hosted service offering a suite of open-source observability tools, including Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Tempo, as a unified platform.
examples: Many organizations use Grafana Cloud to monitor their infrastructure.
Grafana Cloud simplifies the management of observability stacks.
The team migrated their monitoring to Grafana Cloud for better scalability.
